objects.taxonomy_description: Edible fungus with a characteristic cap-and-stem morphology. The cap (pileus) is convex to flat, typically 3-10 cm in diameter, with a smooth or slightly scaly surface in white, brown, or tan coloration. The underside reveals gills (lamellae) radiating from the stem, ranging from white to dark brown. The cylindrical stem (stipe) is smooth, firm, and white, typically 3-8 cm in length. The overall form is umbrella-like with a fleshy, moist texture.

Flower_or_Top: Cap (pileus) is distinctly fleshy and thick, convex becoming broadly convex to flat only when highly mature.
Smooth or slightly scaly surface in white, brown, or tan coloration.
Underside reveals gills (lamellae) radiating from stem.
Stem_and_Leaves: Cylindrical stem (stipe) is smooth, firm, and white, notably stout relative to the cap width.
Gills range from white to dark brown underneath cap.
Overall umbrella-like form with fleshy, moist texture.

objects.taxonomy_description: A medium-sized mammal characterized by a distinctive facial mask and ringed tail, distinguishable from similar carnivores by these specific visual markers.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Facial_Masking: Presence of a prominent black patch of fur around the eyes resembling a bandit's mask.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Tail_Patterning: Tail exhibits distinct alternating dark and light rings along its length.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Body_Silhouette: Stocky, robust body shape with short legs and a pointed snout, differing from the slender build of weasels or the larger frame of bears.

objects.taxonomy_description: Uncastrated adult male sheep measuring 65-110 cm at withers weighing 35-180 kg. Body covered with dense woolly fleece in white, brown, or black. Head broad with laterally spiraling horns (in horned breeds). Horns thick and ridged. Eyes dark with horizontal rectangular pupils. Ears lateral and drooping. Neck thick and muscular. Body compact and stocky. Legs sturdy with cloven hooves. Tail short. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, wool insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Secondary sexual characteristics include larger size and prominent horns.

Head_and_Face: Broad head with laterally spiraling horns (in horned breeds).
Dark eyes with horizontal rectangular pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body covered with dense woolly fleece in white, brown, or black.
Compact stocky body with moderate to substantial proportions at the withers.
